BiblicalUsage: Sephar is a census, a counting of people. Solomon used it to number all the strangers in the land of Israel, counting them the way David his father had counted them before him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts His people — no one is a number to Him, yet no one is overlooked either.
